why:
The criterion fails. Step 5 of the builder brief gives the builder the verifier's own probe. It has the builder run `c=$(printf 'name,age,city
Ada,36,London
Lin,,Paris
' | node bin/csv2json.js); t=$(printf 'name	age	city
Ada	36	London
Lin		Paris
' | node bin/csv2json.js --tsv); [ "$c" = "$t" ] && echo SAME || echo DIFFERENT` and "confirm it prints SAME". Verifier Check 1 runs the same inline script with the same inputs, and its PASS condition is that the last line is SAME. That is a shared probe with its expected output, so it is not just a command named by an expect line. Telling the builder to run `npm test` and write its own --tsv test (step 3, with a different table) is allowed, and the README step doesn't copy the verifier's grep. Step 5 alone is enough to break the criterion.
